Every guide below is written for this entry in its own words and names its source; where guides are still confirming a method, it says so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. In practice the last ones to land are usually the final story mission and A Long Road (100% completion), so the Platinum follows right after those. Guides put the whole run at around 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it pops at the end of it. Just play the story — this is the first mission of the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when the Chapter 1 finale mission ends. Keep playing the main story missions until the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when Chapter 2 ends. Play through the chapter's story missions in order.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when Chapter 3 ends. Play through the chapter's story missions in order.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when Chapter 4 ends. Play through the chapter's story missions in order.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when the final story mission ends and the credits roll. After it, the whole of Leonida stays open for clean-up, and the in-game 100% checklist unlocks.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Breakfast Run when the story offers it. It pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission The Cartel Heist when the story offers it. It pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Child's Play when the story offers it. It pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Headliners when the story offers it. It pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission VCIA Takedown when the story offers it. It pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Operation Savage Glory when the story offers it. It pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list and the last one most players earn. Finish the story first: the in-game 100% checklist only unlocks after the credits, and it then tracks everything left — activities, collectibles, challenges and stranger strands. Work through that checklist in the open world until it reads 100%. Guides rank this the hardest step and put the full Platinum run at around 200 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunt jumps and unique stunts across Leonida. Stunt jumps are the ramps and jumps scattered around the map — hit them in a fast car or on a bike and each one you land counts. Work through them as you explore; the counter is cumulative, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of every activity type the game offers — guides count nine types (races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and more). You only need to try each once, not win or finish it, so sample everything as you come across it and the trophy pops after the last new type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 in total. Visit the shooting ranges across Leonida, work through each challenge and keep retrying until you hit the gold score. Take your time and learn each range's targets before going for gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race — fly the course, beat the time or the rivals, and move on to the next. The locations stay open after the story, so clean them up whenever you like.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — street races, off-road, boat and air races all count as long as each one is a different race. Enter races from the map, win them one by one, and the trophy pops on the 20th distinct win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land the better catch within the time limit. If you lose, challenge him again — there is no penalty for retrying.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play an arcade game through to its end at any arcade in Leonida. You do not need a high score — just finish one game and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's stranger mission strand until its final mission — GTAScoop's guide names that last mission Puff Puff Pass — and finish it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so keep an eye on the map for Andy's icon.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's stranger mission strand until its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so keep an eye on the map for Kenton's icon.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's stranger mission strand until its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so keep an eye on the map for Billy's icon.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a small chain of missions for one stranger — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and others. Finish any eight strands end to end and the trophy pops; the five stranger-final trophies above are part of the same work.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work through Randy's stranger mission strand until its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so keep an eye on the map for Randy's icon.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work through Tyrone's stranger mission strand until its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so keep an eye on the map for Tyrone's icon.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE LIST'S ONLY POSSIBLY-MISSABLE TROPHY — do this as you go, not at the end. Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida (18 spots, per KeenGamer). Guides flag one spot as only reachable in Chapter 1 — GTABase and PowerPyx both warn about it, and GTAScoop places it at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — so meditate at every spot you find in Chapter 1 before the story moves on. After the story, any spot you missed in later chapters can still be visited, but the Chapter 1 one cannot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunting request and track down the unique animal he names. Hunting is about patience: follow the trail, stay downwind, and take the shot cleanly. The animal is a one-off, so finish the hunt when Bret offers it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect the cards to complete three full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, hidden spots and mission rewards — so pick them up as you explore and check your collection to see which sets are close to complete. Three finished sets pop the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. It is a slow grind, so tag a location whenever you pass one instead of saving it all for the end — the counter is cumulative and nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's Challenges — the small goals the game tracks across driving, combat, activities and exploration. They tick over naturally as you play everything else; open the Challenges list now and then and chase the easy ones to reach 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The easiest way is to cause chaos together until the fourth star appears, then break line of sight, hide, and wait for the wanted level to fade — it pops once you are clean.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops one after another without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route through three nearby shops, hit them fast, and keep moving — if the wanted level drops to zero before the third robbery, the chain breaks and you start again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Every new vehicle you get into or photograph counts, so drive everything you see — traffic, parked cars, boats and bikes — and the counter climbs. It is cumulative, so just keep sampling new rides as you play.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus (slow-motion aiming) and take down five enemies before it ends. The best spot is a fight with plenty of enemies grouped together — wait until they cluster, trigger Combat Focus, and work through five of them. If you fall short, retry the fight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave by an unscheduled route — take a plane (or another aircraft) out of the airport without going through a booked flight. Get to the airfield, grab an aircraft and take off; the trophy pops once you are airborne and away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank. Rhinos show up around military areas and at high wanted levels — steal one, climb in, and the trophy pops. Expect heavy police attention once you are in it, so be ready to drive it out fast.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — back out and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big scores — crack the vault, grab the cash, and get clear of the police before the escape counts. Five successful vault jobs pop the trophy.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the police. One clean getaway pops the trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida until the map is fully revealed. Drive, fly and sail into every corner — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the countryside — and the trophy pops once the last area is discovered. It pairs naturally with the collectible and stunt clean-up.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations — find one per gang, hit it, and move on to the next. The trophy pops once every gang has been hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment trophy — find the right spot on the beachfront, sit down with a drink, and it pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through the front of a vehicle showroom and out the other side — the classic GTA exit. Pick a showroom, build speed, and smash through the glass; the trophy pops as you burst out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. You do not need to win — just play through a game there and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is vague and the guides are still pinning down the exact trigger — it tracks your partnership's public appeal, most likely your following as a duo. Check the cited guide for the confirmed method once it is published, and build your duo's following in the meantime. This entry does not guess at a method the sources have not confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: GTAScoop's guide puts this at 500 Criminal Profile actions — the small criminal acts the game tracks as your profile builds. Do them steadily across the game (robberies, getaways, stunts and chaos all feed the profile) and the trophy pops at 500. The count is cumulative, so it comes naturally with the crime clean-up.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The unlock method is still being confirmed by the trophy guides — the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt after a failure. This entry does not guess: check the cited guide for the confirmed method once it is published. KeenGamer lists it among the entries whose precise method is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The unlock method is still being confirmed by the trophy guides — the description suggests a strange event or easter egg somewhere in Leonida. This entry does not guess: check the cited guide for the confirmed method once it is published. KeenGamer lists it as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Perform a drive-by attack with a melee weapon — strike someone down from a moving vehicle with a bat or similar weapon. KeenGamer notes the precise method is still being confirmed, so if it does not pop at first, check the cited guide for the confirmed setup.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to a contact who cleans them, and the laundered total climbs. It is cumulative, so keep laundering after every big score until you hit $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, cars, anything. The total is cumulative across every shop, so it climbs naturally as you gear up; if you are close, buy a big-ticket item to finish it off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property for sale in Leonida — eight in total, per KeenGamer. Garages let you store your vehicle collection, so buy them as you earn the cash; the trophy pops when the last one is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone, add vehicles you own or find, and the counter climbs — ten registered vehicles pop the trophy.
